messages:
Maya (Product): Quick thread: EU customer asked for data residency + ~50ms p50. Need product route + launch gates. Options: Shielded pools, Region-affinity, or Pilot-shield. Thoughts?

Nina (Infra): Shielded = dedicated in-region pools (strong isolation, higher cost). Affinity = steer to closest pool with controlled fallback (cheaper). Pilot-shield = dedicated for the pilot customer + affinity for org.

Luis (Arch): We must include model-variant compatibility checks for fallbacks. Also define measurable gates: p50/p99, provisioning SLA, and audit export verification.

Priya (SRE): Ops gates: 48h canary with staged ramp (0->10->50->100), error budget during canary <0.01%, automated rollback triggers, and noisy-tenant eviction runbook.

Omar (Sales): Customer will pay for pilot shield if timeline ~8 weeks and we provide a security one-pager. I can line up pilot contacts.

Maya (Product): Proposed prioritization: 1) Pilot-shield for single EU customer (fastest revenue), 2) affinity telemetry & fallback robustness, 3) generalize shielded pools once demand justifies. Action items: Nina add cost/capacity to RFC by Tue; Luis spike on model parity (1w); Priya draft SRE checklist; Omar confirm pilot. ops-bot: attach RFC template /rfc/routing-pilot-template.md
